title: Place Value Factory — factory-city login background
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: full-bleed background illustration for the login screen of the children's educational game Place Value Factory.
Primary request: an exciting, beautiful city made ENTIRELY of factories, presented as one cohesive imaginative industrial world.
Scene: a broad sunny panorama of an inviting toy-like factory metropolis stretching into the distance. Every building is recognizably a factory or workshop, with rounded sawtooth roofs, loading bays, windows, pipes, vents, chimneys with small clean white steam puffs, elevated enclosed conveyor bridges and orderly packing yards. Layer larger factories in the foreground at both sides, midsize connected factory complexes behind them, and a varied skyline of smaller industrial towers in the distance. Connect the buildings logically with curving service roads and conveyor systems so the world feels planned and alive rather than scattered clip art. A few neatly stacked wooden shipping crates belong beside loading bays.
Style: premium polished 3D cartoon game environment, softly beveled shapes, tactile painted metal, expressive architectural silhouettes, crisp detailed edges, appealing warm light and rich ambient shading. Match the playful, shiny blue/cyan/orange/purple/green factory world of a primary-school place-value game. Visually rich but coherent, with large readable shapes.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge artwork, slightly elevated three-quarter view with a believable shared perspective. Leave the central 30 percent of the composition quieter and lower contrast so a tall login panel can later overlay it. Make that center a natural open factory courtyard and distant skyline, NOT a blank white patch or empty panel. Keep the most distinctive buildings and lively machinery on the left and right. Carry real scenery across the entire image. Keep the upper sky to about one quarter of the image. Bold welcoming factory silhouettes should still read when the background is cropped for a smaller screen.
Lighting and palette: bright clear cyan sky, soft clouds, warm golden afternoon highlights, saturated cobalt blue and turquoise with balanced orange, golden yellow, purple and green factory accents. Cheerful, wondrous and welcoming.
Constraints: BACKGROUND ART ONLY. No login form, no UI, no buttons, no title, no signs or lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no border. No houses, residential towers, office skyscrapers, retail shops, people or mascot characters. No grim industrial pollution, smokey haze, rust or abandoned buildings.
